.tool-menu{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 6px);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:6px;min-width:180px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);z-index:999;}
.tool-menu .tm-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:var(--text1);transition:background .15s;}
.tool-menu .tm-item:hover{background:rgba(0,180,216,0.1);}
.tool-menu .tm-item svg{flex-shrink:0;width:16px;height:16px;}

#pwInput{width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text1);outline:none;box-sizing:border-box;}

#pwBox .pw-confirm:hover{opacity:0.9;}

function updateCustomerStats(){
  const now=new Date();
  const thisYear=now.getFullYear();
  const thisWeek=getWeekNumber(now);
  const thisMonth=now.getMonth();

  // 2026客户统计
  const y2026=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    return new Date(c.createdDate).getFullYear()===2026;
  }).length;

  // 2025客户统计
  const y2025=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    return new Date(c.createdDate).getFullYear()===2025;
  }).length;

  // 本周新客户:基于 custDateFilter 动态计算
  const filterDate=custDateFilter?new Date(custDateFilter):null;
  const filterYear=filterDate?filterDate.getFullYear():thisYear;
  const filterWeek=filterDate?getWeekNumber(filterDate):thisWeek;
  const filterMonth=filterDate?filterDate.getMonth():thisMonth;
  const weekly=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    const d=new Date(c.createdDate);
    return d.getFullYear()===filterYear&&getWeekNumber(d)===filterWeek;
  }).length;

  // 本月新客户:基于 custDateFilter 动态计算
  const monthly=data.customers.filter(c=>{
    if(!c.createdDate) return false;
    const d=new Date(c.createdDate);
    return d.getFullYear()===filterYear&&d.getMonth()===filterMonth;
  }).length;

  const el2026=document.getElementById('cust2026');
  const el2025=document.getElementById('cust2025');
  const elWeek=document.getElementById('custWeek');
  const elMonth=document.getElementById('custMonth');

  if(el2026)el2026.textContent=y2026;
  if(el2025)el2025.textContent=y2025;
  if(elWeek)elWeek.textContent=weekly;
  if(elMonth)elMonth.textContent=monthly;
}

function getWeekNumber(d){
  const date=new Date(d);
  date.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  // Saturday-based weeks: find first Saturday of year, then calculate week number
  const year=date.getFullYear();
  const jan1=new Date(year,0,1);
  const daysToSaturday=(6-jan1.getDay()+7)%7;
  const firstSaturday=new Date(jan1);
  firstSaturday.setDate(jan1.getDate()+daysToSaturday);
  if(date<firstSaturday)return 1;
  const diffDays=Math.floor((date-firstSaturday)/(1000*60*60*24));
  return Math.floor(diffDays/7)+2;
}

var wrCurrentWeek=parseInt(localStorage.getItem('wr_last_week'))||parseInt(getWeekNumber(new Date()))||28;

function initWeeklyReport(){
  if(!data.weeklyReports)data.weeklyReports={};
  if(!data.weeklyReports.users)data.weeklyReports.users={};
  ['tony','quoc','huong'].forEach(function(u){if(!data.weeklyReports.users[u])data.weeklyReports.users[u]={};});
}


function getWeekDates(weekNum,year){
  year=year||2026;
  // Find first Saturday of the year (Week 1 starts from first Saturday)
  var jan1=new Date(year,0,1);
  var daysToSaturday=(6-jan1.getDay()+7)%7; // Days until first Saturday
  var week1Saturday=new Date(jan1);
  week1Saturday.setDate(jan1.getDate()+daysToSaturday);
  var targetSaturday=new Date(week1Saturday);
  targetSaturday.setDate(week1Saturday.getDate()+(weekNum-2)*7);
  var targetNextSaturday=new Date(targetSaturday);
  targetNextSaturday.setDate(targetSaturday.getDate()+7);
  var months=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  return{start:months[targetSaturday.getMonth()]+' '+targetSaturday.getDate()+', '+targetSaturday.getFullYear(),end:months[targetNextSaturday.getMonth()]+' '+targetNextSaturday.getDate()+', '+targetNextSaturday.getFullYear()};
}

function wrUpdateDisplay(){
  var wDisp=document.getElementById('wrWeekDisplay');
  if(wDisp)wDisp.textContent='Week '+wrCurrentWeek;
  var wDates=document.getElementById('wrWeekDates');
  if(wDates){
    var dates=getWeekDates(wrCurrentWeek);
    wDates.textContent=dates.start+' - '+dates.end;
  }
  wrUpdateRecordsCount();
}

function wrUpdateRecordsCount(){
  var el=document.getElementById('wrRecordsCount');
  if(el){
    var userWeeks=data.weeklyReports&&data.weeklyReports.users&&data.weeklyReports.users[wrCurrentUser]||{};
    var count=Object.keys(userWeeks).filter(function(w){return userWeeks[w]&&userWeeks[w].tasks&&userWeeks[w].tasks.length>0;}).length;
    el.textContent=count;
  }
}

function wrToggleRecords(){
  wrRecordsVisible=!wrRecordsVisible;
  var panel=document.getElementById('wrRecordsPanel');
  if(panel)panel.style.display=wrRecordsVisible?'block':'none';
  if(wrRecordsVisible)wrRenderRecordsList();
}

function wrRenderRecordsList(){
  var list=document.getElementById('wrRecordsList');
  if(!list)return;
  var userWeeks=data.weeklyReports&&data.weeklyReports.users&&data.weeklyReports.users[wrCurrentUser]||{};
  var titleEl=document.getElementById('wrRecordsTitle');
  if(titleEl)titleEl.textContent='Week Records - '+wrUserNames[wrCurrentUser];
  var html='';
  for(var w=Math.max(22,wrCurrentWeek-7);w<=wrCurrentWeek+2;w++){
    var weekData=userWeeks[w];
    var isActive=w===wrCurrentWeek;
    var hasData=weekData&&weekData.tasks&&weekData.tasks.length>0;
    var dates=getWeekDates(w);
    var taskCount=hasData?weekData.tasks.length:0;
    var leftColor=isActive?'var(--blue)':(hasData?'#22c55e':'var(--border)');
    var bgColor=isActive?'rgba(0,180,216,0.1)':'';
    html+='<div onclick="wrLoadWeek('+w+')" style="padding:12px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;background:'+bgColor+';border-left:3px solid '+leftColor+'">'+
      '<div><div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;">Week '+w+'</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);">'+dates.start+' - '+dates.end+'</div></div>'+
      '<span style="font-size:11px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;'+(hasData?'background:rgba(34,197,94,0.2);color:#4ade80;':'background:rgba(113,113,122,0.2);color:#94a3b8;')+'">'+(hasData?taskCount+' tasks':'Empty')+'</span></div>';
  }
  list.innerHTML=html;
}

function wrChangeWeek(direction){
  wrCurrentWeek=Math.max(1,Math.min(52,wrCurrentWeek+direction));
  localStorage.setItem('wr_last_week',wrCurrentWeek);
  wrUpdateDisplay();
  wrRenderWeeklyReportTable();
  if(wrRecordsVisible)wrRenderRecordsList();
}

function wrLoadWeek(weekNum){
  wrCurrentWeek=weekNum;
  localStorage.setItem('wr_last_week',wrCurrentWeek);
  wrUpdateDisplay();
  wrRenderWeeklyReportTable();
  if(wrRecordsVisible){wrRenderRecordsList();wrToggleRecords();}
  wrShowToast('Week '+weekNum+' loaded!','success');
}

function wrAutoCalculate(user,taskId){
  var planStart=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-start');
  var planEnd=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-end');
  var planDays=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-days');
  if(planStart&&planEnd&&planDays){
    var start=planStart.value?new Date(planStart.value):null;
    var end=planEnd.value?new Date(planEnd.value):null;
    if(start&&end&&!isNaN(start)&&!isNaN(end)){
      var days=Math.ceil((end-start)/(1000*60*60*24));
      planDays.textContent=days>=0?days:'-';
    }else{
      planDays.textContent='-';
    }
  }
}


function wrUpdateStatusColor(sel){
  var v=sel.value;
  var bg={'In Progress':'rgba(245,158,11,0.2)','Completed':'rgba(34,197,94,0.2)','Delay':'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)'};
  var fg={'In Progress':'#fbbf24','Completed':'#22c55e','Delay':'#ef4444'};
  if(bg[v]){sel.style.background=bg[v];sel.style.color=fg[v];}
  else{sel.style.background='var(--bg2)';sel.style.color='var(--text)';}
}
function wrUpdateFromPct(user,taskId,pctVal){
  var pctInput=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-pct');
  if(!pctInput)return;
  var clamped=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,parseInt(pctVal,10)||0));
  pctInput.value=clamped;
  // Auto-set Status based on %
  var statusSelect=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-status');
  var statusTxt=document.getElementById(user+'-'+taskId+'-status-txt');
  var newStatus;
  if(clamped===100) newStatus='Completed';
  else if(clamped>=1) newStatus='In Progress';
  else newStatus='Delay'; // 0%
  if(statusSelect){
    statusSelect.value=newStatus;
    wrUpdateStatusColor(statusSelect);
  }
  if(statusTxt){
    var fg={'In Progress':'#fbbf24','Completed':'#22c55e','Delay':'#ef4444'};
    statusTxt.textContent=newStatus;
    statusTxt.style.color=fg[newStatus];
  }
}

function wrDeleteTask(user,taskId){
  if(!confirm('Delete this task?'))return;
  // Remove from data layer first
  var weekData=data.weeklyReports.users[user]&&data.weeklyReports.users[user][wrCurrentWeek];
  if(weekData&&weekData.tasks){
    weekData.tasks.splice(taskId-1,1);
  }
  // Remove DOM element
  var taskEl=document.getElementById('wr-task-'+user+'-'+taskId);
  if(taskEl)taskEl.remove();
  // Renumber remaining tasks both in DOM and data
  var container=document.getElementById('wrTableContainer');
  if(!container)return;
  var groups=container.querySelectorAll('.wr-task-group');
  groups.forEach(function(group,idx){
    var newNum=idx+1;
    var oldNum=parseInt(group.id.replace('wr-task-'+user+'-',''));
    if(newNum===oldNum)return;
    group.id='wr-task-'+user+'-'+newNum;
    // Update # header number
    var headerRow=group.querySelector('div');
    if(headerRow){
      var firstCell=headerRow.children[0];
      if(firstCell)firstCell.textContent='#'+newNum;
    }
    // Update element IDs
    var suffixs=['-name','-start','-end','-days','-status','-pct','-noted'];
    suffixs.forEach(function(suf){
      var oldEl=document.getElementById(user+'-'+oldNum+suf);
      if(oldEl)oldEl.id=user+'-'+newNum+suf;
    });
    // Update delete button onclick
    var delBtn=group.querySelector('button');
    if(delBtn)delBtn.setAttribute('onclick',"wrDeleteTask('"+user+"',"+newNum+")");
    // Update date input onchange
    var dateInputs=group.querySelectorAll('input[type="date"]');
    dateInputs.forEach(function(inp){
      inp.setAttribute('onchange',"wrAutoCalculate('"+user+"',"+newNum+")");
    });
  });
  // Save to localStorage
  localStorage.setItem('weeklyReports',JSON.stringify(data.weeklyReports));
  wrShowToast('Task deleted & renumbered!','success');
}

    var noted=document.getElementById(wrCurrentUser+'-'+taskId+'-noted');

    tasks.push({id:taskId,name:name?name.value:'',planStart:planStart?planStart.value:'',planEnd:planEnd?planEnd.value:'',taskStatus:planStatus?planStatus.value:'',pct:pctVal?pctVal.value:'',noted:noted?noted.value:''});
  });
  data.weeklyReports.users[wrCurrentUser][wrCurrentWeek]={week:wrCurrentWeek,tasks:tasks,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  saveData();
  wrTaskCounter[wrCurrentUser]=tasks.length;
  wrUpdateRecordsCount();
  wrShowToast('Week '+wrCurrentWeek+' saved!','success');

  // ===== AUTO CARRY-FORWARD: Always copy tasks to next week on every save =====
  var nextWeek=wrCurrentWeek+1;
  if(nextWeek>52)return; // Don't carry beyond week 52
  if(tasks.length>0){
    var carriedTasks=tasks.map(function(t,idx){
      return{
        id:idx+1,
        name:t.name||'',
        planStart:t.planStart||'',
        planEnd:t.planEnd||'',
        taskStatus:'In Progress',
        pct:t.pct||'50',
        noted:t.noted||''
      };
    });
    data.weeklyReports.users[wrCurrentUser][nextWeek]={week:nextWeek,tasks:carriedTasks,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
    saveData();
    wrShowToast('Tasks carried forward to Week '+nextWeek,'info');
  }
}

function wrClearAllData(){
  if(!data.weeklyReports||!data.weeklyReports.users)return;
  var users=Object.keys(data.weeklyReports.users);
  users.forEach(function(u){
    var weeks=Object.keys(data.weeklyReports.users[u]);
    weeks.forEach(function(w){
      // Only clear pct and taskStatus, keep other fields
      if(data.weeklyReports.users[u][w]&&data.weeklyReports.users[u][w].tasks){
        data.weeklyReports.users[u][w].tasks.forEach(function(t){

          t.planEnd='';
          t.noted='';
        });
      }
    });
  });
  saveData();

  if(document.getElementById('wrTableContainer'))initWeeklyReport();

function calcRate(actual,annual,qTarget,mid){
  if(actual===''||isNaN(parseFloat(actual))) return null;
  var tgt=(qTarget!==''&&!isNaN(parseFloat(qTarget)))?parseFloat(qTarget):annual;
  var a=parseFloat(actual);
  if(mid==='system') return Math.min(100,Math.round(a*100/tgt));
  return Math.min(100,Math.round(a/tgt*100));
}

function escHtml(str){

function darken(hex){
  var r=Math.max(0,parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16)-40);
  var g=Math.max(0,parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16)-40);
  var b=Math.max(0,parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16)-40);
  return '#'+r.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')+g.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')+b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0');
}

function updateStats(){
  const sm={
    '评审中':'c3','评审中 / Reviewing':'c3','Reviewing':'c3','Reviewing / 评审中':'c3',
    '中标':'c5','中标 / Won':'c5','Won':'c5','Won / 中标':'c5',
    '未中标':'c5','未中标 / Lost':'c5','Lost':'c5','Lost / 未中标':'c5'
  };
  // 阶段内容映射(基于 stageContent,非投标阶段 stage)
  const scm={
    '投标中':'c2','投标中 / Bidding':'c2','Bidding':'c2','Bidding / 投标中':'c2',
    '跟踪':'c4','跟踪 / Following':'c4','Following':'c4','Following / 跟踪':'c4'
  };
  const c={c1:0,c2:0,c3:0,c4:0,c5:0,ca:0,cba:0};
  // 项目统计:跟随 Summary 页面 sumBidsTotal
  c.c1 = data.bids.length;
  // 阶段统计:排除已取消,基于 stageContent
  data.bids.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.inactive) return;
    // 优先用阶段内容判断投标中/跟踪
    const scKey=scm[b.stageContent];
    if(scKey){c[scKey]++;return;}
    // 其他阶段走原逻辑
    const k=sm[b.stage];
    if(k) c[k]++;
  });
  // 统计分类(含已取消)
  c.ca = data.bids.filter(b=>b.category==='A'||b.category==='A工程').length;
  c.cba = data.bids.filter(b=>b.category==='B'||b.category==='B工程').length;
  Object.keys(c).forEach(k=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(k);
    if(el) el.textContent=c[k];
  });
  // 计算预估工程金额总额(排除已取消项目)
  let totalVal = 0;
  data.bids.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.inactive) return; // 已取消项目不计入
    const num = parseFloat(String(b.estimatedValue).replace(/,/g,''));
    if(!isNaN(num)) totalVal += num;
  });
  const tvEl = document.getElementById('totalValue');
  if(tvEl){
    if(totalVal >= 1000000000) tvEl.textContent = (totalVal/1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'B';
    else if(totalVal >= 1000000) tvEl.textContent = (totalVal/1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'M';
    else if(totalVal >= 1000) tvEl.textContent = (totalVal/1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'K';
    else tvEl.textContent = totalVal.toLocaleString();
  }
}

  if(mod==='customers' && custCountryFilter!=='all'){
    d=d.filter(c=>c.country===custCountryFilter);
  }
  // 客户管理公司名称搜索
  if(mod==='customers' && custSearchFilter){
    d=d.filter(c=>{
      const cn=(c.companyName||'').toLowerCase();
      return cn.includes(custSearchFilter);
    });
  }
  // 客户管理日期搜索
  if(mod==='customers' && custDateFilter){
    d=d.filter(c=>c.createdDate===custDateFilter);
  }
  // 商会信息日期筛选
  if(mod==='chambers'){
    if(chamberDateFilter!=='all'){
      d=d.filter(c=>{
        if(!c.attendanceDate) return false;
        const d2=new Date(c.attendanceDate);
        return chamberDateFilter==='upcoming'?d2>=now:d2<now;
      });
    }
    if(chamberMonthFilter!=='all'){
      d=d.filter(c=>{
        if(!c.attendanceDate) return false;
        return new Date(c.attendanceDate).getMonth().toString()===chamberMonthFilter;
      });
    }
  }
  // 投标项目:筛选和排序
  if(mod==='bids'){
    if(bidsFilter==='bidding'){
      d=d.filter(b=>!b.inactive&&(b.stageContent==='投标中'||b.stageContent==='投标中 / Bidding'||b.stageContent==='Bidding'||b.stageContent==='Bidding / 投标中'));
    }else if(bidsFilter==='tracking'){
      d=d.filter(b=>!b.inactive&&(b.stageContent==='跟踪'||b.stageContent==='跟踪 / Following'||b.stageContent==='Following'||b.stageContent==='Following / 跟踪'));
    }else if(bidsFilter==='potential'){
      d=d.filter(b=>!b.inactive&&(b.stageContent==='潜在'||b.stageContent==='潜在 / Potential'||b.stageContent==='Potential'||b.stageContent==='Potential / 潜在'));
    }
    d=[...d].sort((a,b)=>(a.inactive?1:0)-(b.inactive?1:0));
  }
  // 商会信息:出席状态自动勾选(已过日期=已出席,未到=即将出席)
  if(mod==='chambers'){
    d=[...d].sort((a,b)=>{
      if(!a.attendanceDate) return 1;
      if(!b.attendanceDate) return -1;
      return new Date(b.attendanceDate)-new Date(a.attendanceDate);
    });
  }
  // 客户互动:按互动日期倒序排列(最新在前)
  if(mod==='projects'){
    d=[...d].sort((a,b)=>{
      if(!a.interactionDate) return 1;
      if(!b.interactionDate) return -1;
      return new Date(b.interactionDate)-new Date(a.interactionDate);
    });
  }
  console.log('[RENDER] After filters, records to show =', d.length);
  const f=getFields(mod),ff=f.filter(x=>x.l);
  // 投标项目添加暂停/取消勾选列;商会信息添加出席状态列
  const isBids=mod==='bids';
  const isChambers=mod==='chambers';
  const actionCol=isBids?'<th class="text-center" title="暂停/取消">☑</th>':isChambers?'<th class="text-center" title="已出席">☑</th>':'';
  const cols=ff.map(x=>x.l).concat(mod==='projects'?['互动次数 / Interactions']:isChambers?[]:t('c20')).concat(isChambers?['attendanceStatus']:[]);
  document.querySelector('#dt thead').innerHTML='<tr>'+cols.map((c,i)=>{
    const firstMod=mod==='bids'?'customerName':mod==='customers'?'companyName':mod==='projects'?'customerName':'chamberName';
    const isFirst=ff[i]&&ff[i].k===firstMod;
    const cls=isFirst?' class="col-customer"':'';
    const resize=isFirst?'<div class="col-resize" onmousedown="startColResize(event)"></div>':'';
    return'<th'+cls+'>'+c+resize+'</th>';
  }).join('')+actionCol+'</tr>';
  const tb=document.getElementById('tb');
  if(d.length===0){tb.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="'+cols.length+'" class="text-center py-12 text-[var(--muted)]"><svg class="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4"/></svg><p>'+t('nd')+'</p><p class="text-sm mt-1">'+t('ndh')+'</p></td></tr>';return;}
  const actionColCount=mod==='bids'?1:0;
  tb.innerHTML=d.map((item,i)=>'<tr class="ai'+(item.inactive?' row-inactive':'')+'" style="animation-delay:'+(0.7+i*0.05)+'s">'+renderRow(item,i)+'</tr>').join('');
}

      v='<span class="text-[var(--text2)]">'+v+'</span>';

    }

        '低':'bdgLow','低 / Low':'bdgLow','Low':'bdgLow'
      };
      const pLabel={high:'高 / High',med:'中 / Medium',low:'低 / Low'};
      const cur=item.priority||'';
      let short=cur;
      if(cur.includes('高')||cur==='High') short='高';
      else if(cur.includes('中')||cur==='Medium') short='中';
      else if(cur.includes('低')||cur==='Low') short='低';

      v='<span class="bdg '+cls+' bdg-priority" onclick="cyclePriority(\''+item.id+'\')" title="点击切换 / Click to change">'+short+'</span>';

    if(x.k==='estimatedValue'&&item.estimatedValue){
      const num=parseFloat(String(item.estimatedValue).replace(/,/g,''));
      if(!isNaN(num)){
        if(num>=1000000000){v=(num/1000000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'')+'B VND';}
        else if(num>=1000000){v=(num/1000000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'')+'M VND';}
        else if(num>=1000){v=(num/1000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,'')+'K VND';}
        else{v=num+' VND';}
      }
    }
    // 可编辑单元格(投标模块和客户互动模块的字段)
    if((mod==='bids'||mod==='projects')&&x.ed){
      const val=String(item[x.k]||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'").replace(/\n/g,'\\n');
      const escVal=val.replace(/"/g,'"');
      v='<span class="cell-editable" onclick="openInlineEdit(\''+item.id+'\',\''+x.k+'\',\''+escVal+'\',\''+x.tp+'\',\''+(x.opt?x.opt.join('|').replace(/'/g,'''):'')+'\')">'+v+'</span>';
    }
    // 备注字段:限制最大宽度,显示省略号
    if(x.k==='notes'&&v&&v!=='-'){
      v='<span class="text-[var(--text2)]" style="max-width:150px;display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer" title="'+v.replace(/"/g,'"')+'">'+v+'</span>';

    if(mod==='chambers'&&x.k==='attendanceDate'){
      v='<input type="date" value="'+(item.attendanceDate||'')+'" onchange="quickEditDate(\''+item.id+'\',this.value)" class="bg-[var(--bg)] border border-[var(--border)] rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm cursor-pointer" style="color:var(--text);">';
    }
    return'<td class="'+firstCls.trim()+'" style="'+firstStyle+'">'+v+'</td>';
  }).join('');
  // 投标项目:添加暂停/取消勾选格
  if(mod==='bids'){
    const checked=item.inactive?' checked':'';
    cells+='<td class="text-center"><input type="checkbox" '+checked+' onchange="toggleCancelled(\''+item.id+'\',this.checked)" class="w-5 h-5 accent-blue-500 cursor-pointer" title="标记为暂停/取消"></td>';
  }
  // 商会信息:根据日期自动勾选(已过=已出席,未到=即将出席)
  if(mod==='chambers'){
    const isPast=item.attendanceDate&&new Date(item.attendanceDate)<now;
    const checked=isPast?' checked':'';
    const label=isPast?(lang==='zh'?'已出席':'Attended'):(lang==='zh'?'即将出席':'Upcoming');
    cells+='<td class="text-center"><input type="checkbox" '+checked+' class="w-5 h-5 accent-blue-500 cursor-default" title="'+label+'" readonly></td>';
  }
  // 客户互动:显示该公司互动次数(累加 interactionCount 字段)
  if(mod==='projects'){
    var ic=data.projects?data.projects.filter(function(p){return p.interactionDate&&p.customerName&&p.customerName.trim()===(item.customerName||'').trim();}).reduce(function(s,p){return s+(typeof p.interactionCount==='number'?p.interactionCount:0);},0):0;
    cells+='<td class="text-center text-blue-300 font-bold" title="'+ic+' interactions">'+ic+'</td>';
  }

  // 操作按钮
  cells+='<td><div class="flex gap-2"><button onclick="editItem(\''+item.id+'\')" class="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg2)]" title="'+t('me')+'"><svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z"/></svg></button><button onclick="deleteItem(\''+item.id+'\')" class="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-500/10 hover:text-rose-400" title="删除"><svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"/></svg></button></div></td>';
  return cells;
}

      var m2=new Date(p.interactionDate).getMonth();
      return m2>=6&&m2<=8;
    });
    var pic=julRecords.reduce(function(s,p){return s+(typeof p.interactionCount==='number'?p.interactionCount:0);},0);

  }
  // 显示/隐藏「导出互动」按钮
  var expBtn=document.getElementById('expInteractBtn');
  if(expBtn)expBtn.style.display='none';
  var tplBtn=document.getElementById('exportCustTplBtn');
  if(tplBtn)tplBtn.style.display='none';

  updateUI();
  updateCustomerStats();
  if(mod!=='weeklyreport' && mod!=='plan2026' && mod!=='quarterly') renderTable();
}

function backupAll(){
  var backup = {};
  // 保存所有 localStorage 中的数据
  for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
    var key = localStorage.key(i);
    try { backup[key] = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)); }
    catch(e) { backup[key] = localStorage.getItem(key); }
  }
  // 嵌入完整系统代码（index.html），万一重装无需再从 GitHub 拉
  backup._sourceCode = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
  var jsonStr = JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2);
  var blob = new Blob([jsonStr], {type: 'application/json'});
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  a.download = 'BMS_Full_Backup_' + date + '.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  // don't revoke immediately - browser needs time to start download
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }, 1000);
  alert(t('es'));
}

function restoreAll(event){
  var file = event.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    try {
      var backup = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      var count = 0;
      for (var key in backup) {
        if(key==='_sourceCode') continue; // 代码在恢复数据时不写入 localStorage
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(backup[key]));
        count++;
      }
      var codeStr = backup._sourceCode;
      if(codeStr){
        // 也存一份到 localStorage 供手动下载
        localStorage.setItem('_bms_backup_code', codeStr);
        var blob = new Blob([codeStr], {type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8'});
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = 'index.html';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        setTimeout(function(){document.body.removeChild(a);URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);},1000);
      }
      // Push restored data to Firestore before reloading
      if(typeof fdb !== 'undefined'){
        var bmsData = localStorage.getItem('bms_data');
        if(bmsData){
          try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(bmsData);
            fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').set({ data: parsed, updatedBy: 'restore', updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() })
              .then(function(){ console.log('[Restore] Synced to Firestore OK'); location.reload(); })
              .catch(function(e){ console.log('[Restore] Firestore push failed:', e.message); location.reload(); });
          } catch(e){ location.reload(); }
        } else { location.reload(); }
      } else { location.reload(); }
    } catch(err) {
      alert('恢复失败: ' + err.message + '\nRestore failed: ' + err.message);
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
}

function showCloudSnapshots(){
  if(!fauth || !fauth.currentUser && localStorage.getItem('bms_logged_in') !== '1'){
    wrShowToast('Please login first','error'); return;
  }
  // Create modal overlay
  var ov = document.createElement('div');
  ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);z-index:99998;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
  var box = document.createElement('div');
  box.style.cssText = 'background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;max-width:520px;width:90%;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;color:var(--text);font-size:13px;';
  box.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;"><h3 style="margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;">☁️ Cloud Snapshots</h3><button onclick="this.closest(\'div[style]\').parentElement.parentElement.remove()" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text2);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;">✕</button></div><div id="snapshotList" style="min-height:80px;"><p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;">Loading snapshots...</p></div>';
  ov.appendChild(box);
  document.body.appendChild(ov);

  // Fetch snapshots from Firestore
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').collection('snapshots')
    .orderBy('__name__', 'desc').limit(50).get()
    .then(function(snap){
      var list = document.getElementById('snapshotList');
      if(!list) return;
      if(snap.empty){
        list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;padding:20px 0;">No snapshots yet. Save some data first.</p>';
        return;
      }
      var html = '<div style="margin-bottom:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);">Click a snapshot to restore (will overwrite current data):</div>';
      snap.forEach(function(docSnap){
        var ts = docSnap.id;
        var display = ts.replace(/(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/, '$1-$2-$3 $4:$5:$6');
        var updatedBy = docSnap.data().updatedBy || 'unknown';
        html += '<div onclick="restoreFromCloud(\''+ts+'\')" style="padding:10px 14px;margin:4px 0;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transition:0.15s;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--accent)\';this.style.color=\'#fff\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'var(--bg2)\';this.style.color=\'var(--text)\'">';
        html += '<span style="font-weight:600;">'+display+'</span>';
        html += '<span style="font-size:11px;opacity:0.7;">'+updatedBy+'</span>';
        html += '</div>';
      });
      list.innerHTML = html;
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      var list = document.getElementById('snapshotList');
      if(list) list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--danger);text-align:center;">Error: '+e.message+'</p>';
    });
}

function restoreFromCloud(ts){
  if(!confirm('Restore snapshot '+ts+'?\n\nThis will overwrite ALL current data. Are you sure?')) return;
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').collection('snapshots').doc(ts).get()
    .then(function(docSnap){
      if(!docSnap.exists){
        wrShowToast('Snapshot not found','error'); return;
      }
      var snapData = docSnap.data().data || docSnap.data();
      // Write back to master
      return fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').set({ data: snapData, updatedBy: 'restore('+ts+')', updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });
    })
    .then(function(){
      wrShowToast('✅ Restored snapshot '+ts.replace(/(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/, '$1-$2-$3 $4:$5:$6'));
      // Close modal
      var ov = document.querySelector('div[style*="z-index:99998"]');
      if(ov) ov.remove();
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      wrShowToast('Restore failed: '+e.message,'error');
    });
}

function exportCSV(){
  const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

  // 投标项目追踪 CSV
  let csv1 = '\uFEFF'; // BOM for Chinese
  csv1 += '客户名称,项目名称,地点,土地面积(平方米),跟踪日期,投标阶段,下一步日期,下一步内容,备注,负责人,电子邮箱,分类(A/B),预估金额(VND),任务启动日期,已激活内容\n';
  data.bids.forEach(b => {
    csv1 += `"${b.customerName||''}","${b.projectName||''}","${b.location||''}","${b.landArea||''}","${b.trackDate||''}","${b.stage||''}","${b.nextActionDate||''}","${(b.nextActionContent||'').replace(/"/g,'""')}","${(b.notes||'').replace(/"/g,'""')}","${b.personInCharge||''}","${b.email||''}","${b.category||''}","${b.estimatedValue||''}","${b.startDate||''}","${b.stageContent||''}"\n`;
  });

  // 客户管理 CSV
  let csv2 = '\uFEFF';
  csv2 += '公司名称,公司业务,联系人,职位,电话,邮箱,国家,优先级(高/中/低),添加日期\n';
  data.customers.forEach(c => {
    csv2 += `"${c.companyName||''}","${c.companyBusiness||''}","${c.contactPerson||''}","${c.position||''}","${c.phone||''}","${c.email||''}","${c.country||''}","${c.priority||''}","${c.createdDate||''}"\n`;
  });

  // 客户互动 CSV
  let csv3 = '\uFEFF';
  csv3 += '客户名称,互动日期,互动类型,互动内容,负责人,下一步计划,状态,备注\n';
  data.projects.forEach(p => {
    csv3 += `"${p.customerName||''}","${p.interactionDate||''}","${p.interactionType||''}","${(p.content||'').replace(/"/g,'""')}","${p.personInCharge||''}","${p.nextStep||''}","${p.status||''}","${(p.notes||'').replace(/"/g,'""')}"\n`;
  });

  // 商会信息 CSV
  let csv4 = '\uFEFF';
  csv4 += '商会名称,国家,电话,邮箱,联系人,主题,出席日期,出席地点,备注\n';
  data.chambers.forEach(c => {
    csv4 += `"${c.chamberName||''}","${c.country||''}","${c.phone||''}","${c.email||''}","${c.contactPerson||''}","${c.topic||''}","${c.attendanceDate||''}","${c.attendanceLocation||''}","${(c.notes||'').replace(/"/g,'""')}"\n`;
  });

  // 下载4个文件
  const files = [
    {name: `投标项目追踪_${dateStr}.csv`, content: csv1},
    {name: `客户管理_${dateStr}.csv`, content: csv2},
    {name: `客户互动_${dateStr}.csv`, content: csv3},
    {name: `商会信息_${dateStr}.csv`, content: csv4}
  ];

  files.forEach(f => {
    const blob = new Blob([f.content], {type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = f.name;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  });

  alert('已导出4个CSV文件!\n\n请用Excel分别打开编辑,然后点击「导入」导入回来。');
}

function importData(event){
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;

  const fileName = file.name.toLowerCase();

  // Excel 文件导入(使用 SheetJS)
  if(fileName.endsWith('.xls') || fileName.endsWith('.xlsx') || fileName.endsWith('.xlsm') || fileName.endsWith('.xml')){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e){
      try{
        const data2 = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
        const workbook = XLSX.read(data2, {type: 'array'});

        // 遍历所有工作表
        workbook.SheetNames.forEach(sheetName => {
          console.log('发现工作表:', sheetName);
          const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
          const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, {header: 1});

          console.log('工作表', sheetName, '数据行数:', jsonData.length);
          if(jsonData.length > 0) {
            console.log('第一行(标题):', jsonData[0]);
            console.log('第二行(数据):', jsonData[1]);
          }

          if(jsonData.length < 2) return; // 跳过空表

          // 跳过标题行,获取数据行
          const dataRows = jsonData.slice(1).filter(row => row.some(cell => cell && String(cell).trim() !== ''));

          console.log('工作表', sheetName, '有效数据行数:', dataRows.length);

          // 根据工作表名称导入数据(严格匹配,避免误判)
          const sheetNameLower = sheetName.toLowerCase();
          if(sheetNameLower.includes('投标') || sheetNameLower.includes('bid')){
            const existingKeys = new Set(data.bids.map(b => b.customerName + '|' + b.projectName));
            let added = 0;
            dataRows.forEach((row) => {
              const key = String(row[0] || '') + '|' + String(row[1] || '');
              if(existingKeys.has(key)) return;
              existingKeys.add(key);
              data.bids.push({
                id: 'B-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
                customerName: String(row[0] || ''),
                projectName: String(row[1] || ''),
                location: String(row[2] || ''),
                landArea: String(row[3] || ''),
                trackDate: String(row[4] || ''),
                stage: String(row[5] || ''),
                nextActionDate: String(row[6] || ''),
                nextActionContent: String(row[7] || ''),
                notes: String(row[8] || ''),
                personInCharge: String(row[9] || ''),
                email: String(row[10] || ''),
                category: String(row[11] || ''),
                estimatedValue: String(row[12] || ''),
                startDate: String(row[13] || ''),
                stageContent: String(row[14] || '')
              });
              added++;
            });
            console.log('导入投标数据: 新增', added, '条 (已跳过重复)');
          }
          else if(sheetName.includes('客户管理') || sheetName === '客户管理'){
            const existingNames = new Set(data.customers.map(c => c.companyName));
            const headerKeywords = ['公司名称', 'Company Name']; // 跳过表头行
            let added = 0;
            dataRows.forEach((row) => {
              const name = String(row[0] || '').trim();
              if(!name || existingNames.has(name) || headerKeywords.includes(name)) return; // 跳过空行、已存在、表头行
              existingNames.add(name);
              data.customers.push({
                id: 'C-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
                companyName: name,
                companyBusiness: row[1] || '',
                contactPerson: row[2] || '',
                position: row[3] || '',
                phone: row[4] || '',
                email: row[5] || '',
                country: row[6] || '',
                priority: row[7] || '',
                createdDate: row[8] || ''
              });
              added++;
            });
            console.log('导入客户数据: 新增', added, '条 (已跳过重复)');
          }
          else if(sheetName.includes('互动') || sheetName === '客户互动'){
            const existingKeys = new Set(data.projects.map(p => p.customerName + '|' + p.interactionDate + '|' + p.content));
            let added = 0;
            dataRows.forEach((row) => {
              const key = String(row[0] || '') + '|' + String(row[1] || '') + '|' + String(row[3] || '');
              if(existingKeys.has(key)) return;
              existingKeys.add(key);
              data.projects.push({
                id: 'I-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
                customerName: row[0] || '',
                interactionDate: row[1] || '',
                interactionType: row[2] || '',
                content: row[3] || '',
                personInCharge: row[4] || '',
                nextStep: row[5] || '',
                status: row[6] || '',
                notes: row[7] || ''
              });
              added++;
            });
            console.log('导入互动数据: 新增', added, '条 (已跳过重复)');
          }
          else if(sheetName.includes('商会') || sheetName === '商会信息'){
            const existingNames = new Set(data.chambers.map(c => c.chamberName));
            let added = 0;
            dataRows.forEach((row) => {
              const name = String(row[0] || '').trim();
              if(!name || existingNames.has(name)) return;
              existingNames.add(name);
              data.chambers.push({
                id: 'CH-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
                chamberName: name,
                country: row[1] || '',
                phone: row[2] || '',
                email: row[3] || '',
                contactPerson: row[4] || '',
                topic: row[5] || '',
                attendanceDate: row[6] || '',
                attendanceLocation: row[7] || '',
                notes: row[8] || ''
              });
              added++;
            });
            console.log('导入商会数据: 新增', added, '条 (已跳过重复)');
          }
        });

        if(confirm('导入Excel数据将覆盖当前数据,确定继续吗?')){
          saveData();
          updateOptionsFromData();
          updateStats();
          updateCustomerStats();

          // 如果有投标数据,切换到投标项目追踪模块
          if(data.bids.length > 0){
            mod = 'bids';
            // 更新菜单激活状态
            document.querySelectorAll('.ni').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.ni')[0].classList.add('active');
            // 更新标题
            document.getElementById('pt').textContent = '投标项目追踪';
            document.getElementById('ps').textContent = '管理和追踪所有投标项目进度';
            // 显示投标统计,隐藏其他
            document.getElementById('bs').style.display='grid';
            document.getElementById('cs').style.display='none';
            document.getElementById('yf').style.display='none';
          }

          renderTable();
          alert('Excel导入成功!\n\n已导入:\n- 投标项目:' + data.bids.length + ' 条\n- 客户管理:' + data.customers.length + ' 条\n- 客户互动:' + data.projects.length + ' 条\n- 商会信息:' + data.chambers.length + ' 条');
        }
      }catch(err){
        console.error('导入错误:', err);
        alert('Excel导入失败: ' + err.message + '\n\n请确保文件是有效的Excel格式');
      }
    };
    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
  }
  // CSV 文件导入
  else if(fileName.endsWith('.csv')){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e){
      try{
        const text = e.target.result;
        const lines = text.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());

        if(lines.length < 2){
          alert('CSV文件为空或格式不正确');
          return;
        }

        // 解析CSV行
        const parseCSVLine = (line) => {
          const result = [];
          let current = '';
          let inQuotes = false;
          for(let i = 0; i < line.length; i++){
            const char = line[i];
            if(char === '"'){
              if(inQuotes && line[i+1] === '"'){
                current += '"';
                i++;
              }else{
                inQuotes = !inQuotes;
              }
            }else if(char === ',' && !inQuotes){
              result.push(current);
              current = '';
            }else{
              current += char;
            }
          }
          result.push(current);
          return result;
        };

        const dataRows = [];
        for(let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++){
          const row = parseCSVLine(lines[i]);
          if(row.some(v => v && v.trim() !== '')){
            dataRows.push(row);
          }
        }

        // 根据文件名判断导入哪个模块
        if(fileName.includes('投标')){
          data.bids = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'B-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            customerName: row[0] || '',
            projectName: row[1] || '',
            location: row[2] || '',
            landArea: row[3] || '',
            trackDate: row[4] || '',
            stage: row[5] || '',
            personInCharge: row[6] || '',
            email: row[7] || '',
            category: row[8] || '',
            estimatedValue: row[9] || ''
          }));
          saveData();
          updateStats();
          renderTable();
          alert(`投标项目导入成功!共${data.bids.length}条记录`);
        }
        else if(fileName.includes('客户管理') || fileName.includes('客户')){
          data.customers = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'C-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            companyName: row[0] || '',
            companyBusiness: row[1] || '',
            contactPerson: row[2] || '',
            position: row[3] || '',
            phone: row[4] || '',
            email: row[5] || '',
            country: row[6] || '',
            priority: row[7] || '',
            createdDate: row[8] || ''
          }));
          saveData();
          updateCustomerStats();
          renderTable();
          alert(`客户管理导入成功!共${data.customers.length}条记录`);
        }
        else if(fileName.includes('互动')){
          data.projects = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'I-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            customerName: row[0] || '',
            interactionDate: row[1] || '',
            interactionType: row[2] || '',
            content: row[3] || '',
            personInCharge: row[4] || '',
            nextStep: row[5] || '',
            status: row[6] || '',
            notes: row[7] || ''
          }));
          saveData();
          renderTable();
          alert(`客户互动导入成功!共${data.projects.length}条记录`);
        }
        else if(fileName.includes('商会')){
          data.chambers = dataRows.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: 'CH-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx,
            chamberName: row[0] || '',
            country: row[1] || '',
            phone: row[2] || '',
            email: row[3] || '',
            contactPerson: row[4] || '',
            topic: row[5] || '',
            attendanceDate: row[6] || '',
            attendanceLocation: row[7] || '',
            notes: row[8] || ''
          }));
          saveData();
          renderTable();
          alert(`商会信息导入成功!共${data.chambers.length}条记录`);
        }
        else{
          alert('无法识别CSV文件类型,请确保文件名包含:投标、客户管理、互动、商会');
        }
      }catch(err){
        alert('CSV导入失败: ' + err.message);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }
  // JSON 文件导入
  else if(fileName.endsWith('.json')){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e){
      try{
        const imported = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
        if(imported.data){
          if(confirm(t('ic'))){
            data = imported.data;
            saveData();
            updateOptionsFromData();
            updateStats();
            updateCustomerStats();
            renderTable();
            alert(t('is'));
          }
        }else{
          alert(t('ie'));
        }
      }catch(err){
        alert(t('ie') + ': ' + err.message);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }
  else{
    alert('不支持的文件格式,请使用 .xls 或 .json 文件');
  }
  event.target.value = '';
}

function doSave(){
  console.log('[SAVE] doSave called. mod =', mod, '| eid =', eid);
  try {
    if (!data[mod]) {
      alert('错误:模块数据未初始化');
      return;
    }

    const fm = document.getElementById('mf');
    if (!fm) {
      alert('错误:找不到表单元素');
      return;
    }

    console.log('[SAVE] Form found, fields:', fm.querySelectorAll('input, select, .fi-t, .fi-ta').length);
    const item = {id: eid || mod.toUpperCase().slice(0,3)+'-'+Date.now()};

    // 取 select 的值
    fm.querySelectorAll('select').forEach(sel => {
      if (sel.name) item[sel.name] = sel.value;
    });

    // 取原生日期输入框的值
    fm.querySelectorAll('input[type="date"]').forEach(inp => {
      if (inp.dataset.k) item[inp.dataset.k] = inp.value;
    });

    // 取 input[list] datalist 的值
    fm.querySelectorAll('input[list]').forEach(function(el) {
      var k = el.dataset.k;
      if (k) item[k] = el.value || '';
    });
    // 取 contenteditable div 和 input 的值(纯文本/value,用于保存)
    fm.querySelectorAll('.fi-t,.fi-ta').forEach(function(el) {
      var k = el.dataset.k;
      if (!k) return;
      if (el.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        item[k] = el.value || '';
      } else {
        item[k] = el.textContent || '';
      }
    });

    if(eid){
      const idx = data[mod].findIndex(i => i.id === eid);
      console.log('[EDIT] Updating. eid =', eid, '| idx found =', idx);
      if(idx !== -1){
        var oldItem = data[mod][idx];
        if(mod==='projects'){
          var oldDate = oldItem.interactionDate||'';
          var newDate = item.interactionDate||'';
          // 改了日期 -> 又互动了一次 -> +1
          if(oldDate !== newDate){
            var baseCount = (typeof oldItem.interactionCount==='number') ? oldItem.interactionCount : 0;
            item.interactionCount = baseCount + 1;
          } else {
            item.interactionCount = (typeof oldItem.interactionCount==='number') ? oldItem.interactionCount : 0;
          }
        }
        console.log('[EDIT] Before update:', JSON.stringify(data[mod][idx]));
        data[mod][idx] = item;
        console.log('[EDIT] After update:', JSON.stringify(data[mod][idx]));
      } else {
        console.log('[EDIT] WARN: idx not found, pushing as NEW item');
        data[mod].push(item);
      }
    }else{
      // Set createdDate for new customers if not already set
      if(mod==='customers' && !item.createdDate){
        const today=new Date();
        const y=today.getFullYear();
        const m=String(today.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
        const d=String(today.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
        item.createdDate=y+'-'+m+'-'+d;
      }
      data[mod].push(item);
      console.log('[SAVE] Pushed new item. Total', mod, 'now:', data[mod].length);
    }

    saveData();
    console.log('[SAVE] Data saved to localStorage');
    updateOptionsFromData();
    updateStats();
    updateSummary();
    renderTable();
    console.log('[SAVE] Table rendered');

    eid = null;
    cm();

    console.log('[SAVE] Modal closed, alert shown');
    alert('保存成功!');
  } catch(err) {
    alert('保存出错: ' + err.message);
  }
}

// 手动调整第一列宽度
let colResize={active:false,startX:0,startWidth:0};
function startColResize(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  colResize.active=true;
  colResize.startX=e.clientX;
  const th=e.target.parentElement;
  colResize.startWidth=th.offsetWidth;
  document.addEventListener('mousemove',doColResize);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup',stopColResize);
}
function doColResize(e){
  if(!colResize.active)return;
  const dx=e.clientX-colResize.startX;
  const newWidth=Math.max(80,colResize.startWidth+dx);
  document.querySelectorAll('#dt .col-customer').forEach(el=>el.style.minWidth=newWidth+'px');
  document.querySelectorAll('#dt .col-customer').forEach(el=>el.style.width=newWidth+'px');
}
function stopColResize(){
  colResize.active=false;
  document.removeEventListener('mousemove',doColResize);
  document.removeEventListener('mouseup',stopColResize);
}

function getPlanTracking(){
  var stored = data.planTracking;
  // Return stored data as-is (no auto-merge of defaults — deleted items stay deleted)
  if(stored && Array.isArray(stored) && stored.length > 0){
    return stored;
  }
  // First load: seed from defaults
  data.planTracking = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultPlanTracking));
  return data.planTracking;
}

function renderPlanTracking(){
  // Guard: picOptions should be globally defined, but Cloud sync can null it
  var PO = typeof picOptions !== 'undefined' && picOptions ? picOptions : ['Tony','Huong','Quoc','All Members','Tony / Quoc','Huong / Tony','Quoc / Huong'];
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  var container = document.getElementById('planTrackingContainer');
  if(!container) return;

  var isZh = lang==='zh';
  var headers = [
    isZh?'编号':'No.',
    isZh?'内容':'Content',
    isZh?'年度计划':'Annual Plan',
    isZh?'累计':'Cumulative',
    isZh?'负责人':'Person in Charge',
    isZh?'开始':'Date Start',
    isZh?'截止':'Date End',
    isZh?'资源':'Resources',
    isZh?'备注':'Note',
    '' // Action column
  ];

  var widths = ['60px','250px','80px','80px','150px','120px','120px','120px','150px','50px'];
  var html = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed">';
  html += '<colgroup>';
  widths.forEach(function(w,i){
    html += '<col style="width:'+w+'">';
  });
  html += '</colgroup>';
  html += '<thead><tr>';
  headers.forEach(function(h,i){
    html += '<th style="padding:10px 12px;text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);font-size:12px;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(0,180,216,0.4);width:'+widths[i]+'">'+h+'</th>';
  });
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  // Pre-compute parent row pct averages from sub/leaf children
  var parentPctMap = {};
  items.forEach(function(p){
    if(!p.no.includes('.')){
      var subs = items.filter(function(it){ return it.no.startsWith(p.no + '.') && (it.no.match(/\./g) || []).length === 1; });
      if(subs.length > 0){
        var pt = 0, pc = 0;

// Live-update sub/parent row pct display when leaf cumulative changes
function updatePctRowDisplay(){
  var tbody = document.querySelector('#planTrackingContainer table tbody');
  if(!tbody) return;
  var trs = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
  // leaf -> sub mapping
  var subData = {}; // subNo -> [values]
  trs.forEach(function(tr){
    var cells = tr.cells;
    if(!cells || cells.length < 3) return;
    var no = (cells[0].textContent||'').trim();
    var dots = (no.match(/\./g)||[]).length;
    if(dots === 2){ // leaf row
      var subNo = no.split('.').slice(0,2).join('.');
      var cumInput = tr.querySelector('input[data-k="cumulative"]');
      if(cumInput){
        var v = parseFloat(cumInput.value);
        if(!isNaN(v) && v >= 0){
          if(!subData[subNo]) subData[subNo] = [];
          subData[subNo].push(Math.min(Math.round(v), 100));
        }
      }
    }
  });
  // Update sub and parent rows
  trs.forEach(function(tr){
    var cells = tr.cells;
    if(!cells || cells.length < 3) return;
    var no = (cells[0].textContent||'').trim();
    var dots = (no.match(/\./g)||[]).length;
    var td2 = cells[2]; // Column 3 (pct)
    if(!td2) return;
    if(dots === 1){ // sub row
      var vals = subData[no];
      if(vals && vals.length > 0){
        var avg = Math.round(vals.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;}) / vals.length);
        td2.textContent = avg + '%';
        td2.style.color = avg >= 100 ? '#10b981' : (avg > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
      }
    } else if(dots === 0){ // parent row
      var parentSubs = [];
      for(var sn in subData){
        if(sn.split('.')[0] === no){
          var svals = subData[sn];
          if(svals && svals.length > 0){
            parentSubs.push(Math.round(svals.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;}) / svals.length));
          }
        }
      }
      if(parentSubs.length > 0){
        var pavg = Math.round(parentSubs.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;}) / parentSubs.length);
        td2.textContent = pavg + '%';
        td2.style.color = pavg >= 100 ? '#10b981' : (pavg > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
      }
    }
  });
}

// Add child row under a parent/sub node
function addChildRow(parentNo, rootNo){
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  var parentDepth = parentNo.split('.').length;
  // Find direct children only (exactly one more depth level) and track insert position
  var children = [];
  var insertIdx = -1;
  var parentIdx = -1;
  for(var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
    var n = items[i].no;
    if(n === parentNo) { parentIdx = i; }
    if(n.startsWith(parentNo + '.')){
      var d = n.split('.').length;
      if(d === parentDepth + 1){ children.push({no: n, idx: i}); }
      insertIdx = i + 1;
    } else if(insertIdx > 0) { break; }
  }
  if(insertIdx < 0) {
    // No children found — insert right after parent, not at end of list
    insertIdx = parentIdx >= 0 ? parentIdx + 1 : items.length;
  }
  // Find next sequential number (e.g. 1,2,4 → use 5, not 3)
  var childNums = children.map(function(c){ return parseInt(c.no.split('.').pop()); });
  var newNum = childNums.length > 0 ? Math.max.apply(null, childNums) + 1 : 1;
  var newNo = parentNo + '.' + newNum;
  items.splice(insertIdx, 0, {
    no: newNo,
    content: '',
    pct: '',
    annualPlan: '',
    cumulative: '',
    pic: '',
    dateStart: '',
    dateEnd: '',
    resources: '',
    note: ''
  });
  // Clean cumulative values: strip any stored % suffix
  items.forEach(function(it){
    if(it.cumulative && typeof it.cumulative === 'string'){
      it.cumulative = it.cumulative.replace(/%/g,'');
    }
  });
  data.planTracking = items;
  saveData();
  renderPlanTracking();
  // Auto-focus the new row's content field so user can type immediately
  setTimeout(function(){
    var newInput = document.querySelector('.plan-input[data-idx="' + insertIdx + '"][data-k="content"]');
    if(newInput){ newInput.focus(); newInput.select(); }
  }, 50);
}

// Delete a plan row
function deletePlanRow(idx, btn){
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  var item = items[idx];
  if(!item) return;
  var isZh = lang==='zh';
  if(!confirm((isZh?'确定删除「':'Delete "') + item.content + (isZh?'」?\n\n注意：所有子项也会被删除。':'"?\n\nAll child items will also be removed.') + '\n\n编号: ' + item.no)) return;
  var no = item.no;
  // Remove this item and all its children
  items = items.filter(function(it){ return !it.no.startsWith(no + '.') && it.no !== no; });
  // Re-number siblings only when deleting a leaf (depth >= 2 = "X.Y.Z"),
  // not when deleting a sub-parent (depth = 1 = "X.Y") — to avoid cross-category corruption.
  var dotCount = (no.match(/\./g) || []).length;
  if(dotCount >= 1){
    var parentNo = no.substring(0, no.lastIndexOf('.'));
    var siblings = items.filter(function(it){ return it.no.startsWith(parentNo + '.') && (it.no.match(/\./g) || []).length === dotCount; });
    siblings.sort(function(a,b){ return a.no.localeCompare(b.no); });
    var counter = 1;
    siblings.forEach(function(sib){
      var oldNo = sib.no;
      var newNo = parentNo + '.' + counter;
      items.forEach(function(it){
        if(it.no === oldNo) it.no = newNo;
        else if(it.no.startsWith(oldNo + '.')) it.no = newNo + it.no.substring(oldNo.length);
      });
      counter++;
    });
  }
  // Clean cumulative values: strip any stored % suffix
  items.forEach(function(it){
    if(it.cumulative && typeof it.cumulative === 'string'){
      it.cumulative = it.cumulative.replace(/%/g,'');
    }
  });
  data.planTracking = items;
  saveData();
  renderPlanTracking();
}

// Add new top-level category
function addNewCategory(){
  var items = getPlanTracking();
  // Find next available letter
  var usedLetters = items.filter(function(it){ return !it.no.includes('.'); }).map(function(it){ return it.no; });
  var nextLetter = '';
  for(var c = 65; c <= 90; c++){ // A-Z
    var letter = String.fromCharCode(c);
    if(usedLetters.indexOf(letter) < 0){ nextLetter = letter; break; }
  }
  if(!nextLetter){
    alert(lang==='zh'?'已达最大类别数':'Maximum categories reached');
    return;
  }
  items.push({
    no: nextLetter,
    content: '',
    pct: '',
    annualPlan: '',
    cumulative: '',
    pic: '',
    resources: '',
    note: '',
    isParent: true
  });
  // Clean cumulative values: strip any stored % suffix
  items.forEach(function(it){
    if(it.cumulative && typeof it.cumulative === 'string'){
      it.cumulative = it.cumulative.replace(/%/g,'');
    }
  });
  data.planTracking = items;
  saveData();
  renderPlanTracking();
  // Auto-focus the new category content field
  setTimeout(function(){
    var catIdx = items.length - 1;
    var newInput = document.querySelector('.plan-input[data-idx="' + catIdx + '"][data-k="content"]');
    if(newInput){ newInput.focus(); newInput.select(); }
  }, 50);
}

      updateSyncStatus('✅');
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      cloudStatus = 'offline';
      updateSyncStatus('⚠️');
      console.log('[Firebase] Sync error (offline?):', e.message);
    });
};

// ===== REAL-TIME CLOUD LISTENER =====
var _cloudUnsubscribe = null;
var _isSyncingFromOwnSave = false;

function listenToCloud(){
  // Unsubscribe previous listener if any
  if(_cloudUnsubscribe){
    _cloudUnsubscribe();
    _cloudUnsubscribe = null;
  }
  // Allow both Firebase Auth login and simple password login
  var isLoggedIn = localStorage.getItem('bms_logged_in') === '1';
  if(!isLoggedIn) return;
  
  console.log('[Firebase] Starting real-time listener...');
  
  // Check Firebase is available
  if(typeof fdb === 'undefined'){
    console.error('[Firebase] Firestore not initialized!');
    cloudStatus = 'offline'; updateSyncStatus('⚠️');
    return;
  }
  
  cloudStatus = 'synced'; updateSyncStatus('☁️');
  
  _cloudUnsubscribe = fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master')
    .onSnapshot(function(doc){
      console.log('[Firebase] onSnapshot fired, exists:', doc.exists);
      if(!doc.exists || !doc.data().data) return;
      
      // Skip if this change was triggered by our own save
      if(_isSyncingFromOwnSave){
        _isSyncingFromOwnSave = false;
        return;
      }
      
      console.log('[Firebase] Cloud data changed - updating UI!');
      var fbData = doc.data().data;
      
      // Prevent empty/invalid cloud data from overwriting local data
      var fbKeys = Object.keys(fbData || {});
      if(fbKeys.length === 0 || (fbKeys.length === 1 && fbKeys[0] === 'weeklyReports')){
        console.log('[Firebase] Skipping empty/invalid cloud data (keys:', fbKeys.join(','), ')');
        return;
      }
      
      // Only update if data is different from local
      // Full sync: accept cloud data (all modules, all users merged)
      var dataClean = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
      var fbClean = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fbData));
      delete dataClean.weeklyReports; delete fbClean.weeklyReports;
      if(JSON.stringify(dataClean) !== JSON.stringify(fbClean)){
        data = fbData;
        _origSave(); // Save to localStorage
        updateStats(); updateSummary(); updateUI(); if(mod!=='weeklyreport' && mod!=='plan2026' && mod!=='quarterly') renderTable();

        // Show brief notification
        showToast('☁️ Cloud data updated!');
      }
    }, function(error){
      console.warn('[Firebase] Listener error:', error);
      cloudStatus = 'offline'; updateSyncStatus('⚠️');
    });
}

// Load from Firebase (pull latest data)
function syncFromCloud(){
  var isLoggedIn = localStorage.getItem('bms_logged_in') === '1';
  if(!isLoggedIn) return; // Skip if not logged in
  cloudStatus = 'loading'; updateSyncStatus('⏳');
  fdb.collection('bms_data').doc('master').get()
    .then(function(doc){
      if(doc.exists && doc.data().data){
        var fbData = doc.data().data;
        // Full sync: accept cloud data (all modules, all users merged)
        data = fbData;
        _origSave();
        updateStats(); updateSummary(); updateUI(); if(mod!=='weeklyreport' && mod!=='plan2026' && mod!=='quarterly') renderTable();
        cloudStatus = 'synced';
        lastSyncFrom = doc.data().updatedAt ? 'cloud' : 'local';
        updateSyncStatus('☁️');
        console.log('[Firebase] Synced from cloud');
        // Remove login overlay if present
        var overlay = document.getElementById('login-overlay');
        if(overlay){ overlay.remove(); document.body.classList.remove('logged-out'); }
        document.getElementById('cloudStatus').textContent = '☁️';
      } else {
        // No cloud data yet, push local data
        window.saveData();
      }
    })
    .catch(function(e){
      cloudStatus = 'offline';
      updateSyncStatus('⚠️');
      console.log('[Firebase] Load error (offline?):', e.message);
    });
}

// Show sync status indicator
function updateSyncStatus(icon){
  var el = document.getElementById('cloudStatus');
  if(el) {
    el.textContent = icon;
    if(cloudStatus === 'synced') el.className = 'text-green-500 text-sm';
    else if(cloudStatus === 'loading') el.className = 'text-blue-400 text-sm';
    else el.className = 'text-yellow-400 text-sm';
  }
  // Also update header badge
  var hb = document.getElementById('cloudBadge');
  if(hb) {
    hb.textContent = icon;
    var txt = document.getElementById('cloudBadgeTxt');
    if(cloudStatus === 'synced') {
      hb.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card)] border border-green-500/50 cursor-pointer select-none flex items-center gap-1';
      if(txt) { txt.textContent = 'Cloud'; txt.className = 'text-[10px] text-green-400'; }
    } else if(cloudStatus === 'loading') {
      hb.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card)] border border-blue-500/50 cursor-pointer select-none flex items-center gap-1';
      if(txt) { txt.textContent = 'Loading'; txt.className = 'text-[10px] text-blue-400'; }
    } else {
      hb.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--card)] border border-yellow-500/50 cursor-pointer select-none flex items-center gap-1';
      if(txt) { txt.textContent = 'Offline'; txt.className = 'text-[10px] text-yellow-400'; }
    }
  }
}

// Toast notification
function showToast(msg){
  var existing = document.getElementById('cloudToast');
  if(existing) existing.remove();
  var div = document.createElement('div');
  div.id = 'cloudToast';
  div.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--green,#22c55e);color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;z-index:9999;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.3s;';
  div.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(div);
  setTimeout(function(){ div.style.opacity = '1'; }, 50);
  setTimeout(function(){
    div.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(function(){ div.remove(); }, 300);
  }, 2500);
}

// Cloud info popup
function showCloudInfo(){
  var existing = document.getElementById('cloudTooltip');
  if(existing){ existing.remove(); return; }
  var badge = document.getElementById('cloudBadge');
  if(!badge) return;
  var rect = badge.getBoundingClientRect();
  var div = document.createElement('div');
  div.id = 'cloudTooltip';
  div.className = 'cloud-tooltip';
  var statusText = cloudStatus === 'synced' ? '☁️ Connected' : (cloudStatus === 'loading' ? '⏳ Connecting...' : '⚠️ Offline');
  div.innerHTML = '<div class="ctitle">☁️ Cloud Sync</div>' +
    '<div>Status: ' + statusText + '</div>' +
    '<div class="cstatus">Firebase: mgd-bms<br>Storage: Firestore</div>';
  div.style.left = (rect.left - 80) + 'px';
  div.style.top = (rect.bottom + 5) + 'px';
  document.body.appendChild(div);
  // Close on click outside
  setTimeout(function(){
    document.addEventListener('click', function closeTip(e){
      if(!div.contains(e.target) && e.target.id !== 'cloudBadge'){
        div.remove();
        document.removeEventListener('click', closeTip);
      }
    });
  }, 100);
}
